title: SME Growth & Acquisition Intelligence
formatting: Navy #1F3A5F background, white Segoe UI Semibold 20pt title; subtitle in 10pt uses the Data Basis Note measure so the synthetic basis is stated on the page itself
business_question: What am I looking at and on what basis?

title: High-opportunity CMAs
formatting: Whole number; category label 10pt grey; value 28pt navy
business_question: How many markets carry the strongest external signal?

title: Active leads
formatting: Whole number with thousands separator
business_question: How much live demand are we carrying?

title: P1 leads needing action
formatting: Whole number; amber #C8821A value when above 200 via conditional formatting on the value colour
business_question: How much urgent work is in front of the team?

title: Assignment rate
formatting: Percentage 2 decimals
business_question: Does valid demand reliably reach an owner?

title: Contact rate
formatting: Percentage 2 decimals
business_question: Are owned leads actually being worked?

title: Qualification rate (mature)
formatting: Percentage 2 decimals; title must carry the word mature
business_question: How much contacted demand becomes a real conversation?

title: Conversion rate (mature cohort)
formatting: Percentage 2 decimals; title must carry mature cohort
business_question: What is the end-to-end result on cohorts given time to convert?

title: First-contact SLA breach rate
formatting: Percentage 2 decimals; red #9B2C24 value above 10%
business_question: Are we meeting our own response promise?

fields_values_measures: [Captured Leads]; [Valid Leads]; [Assigned Leads]; [Contacted Leads]; [Qualified Leads (Mature)]; [Converted Leads (Mature)]

formatting: Single navy series; data labels on; y-axis title off

title: What the action queue needs
